summary: This directory centralizes security-critical path handling logic, providing essential validation and resolution mechanisms to prevent directory traversal and ensure that all filesystem interactions remain restricted to defined safe base directories.
responsibilities: Prevent unauthorized filesystem access outside defined base boundaries
Normalize paths for secure resolution within application environments
Validate path input to reject traversal or absolute path attempts
relationships: Path resolution procedures verify input against base directories to maintain security boundaries.
The enforcement of access control prevents path traversal attempts before file system access is attempted.
designDecisions: Implementation of strict path containment to prevent security breaches
Use of centralized path resolution logic for consistent security enforcement
Explicit error handling for path security violations
